standard_prerequisites.name: The description of local cohomology through the extended Cech complex on generators of the ideal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1678-1683)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the composition into a statement about tensor products of Cech complexes.

core_obligations: Interpret the statement: the composition is read as including the torsion subcategory into the derived category and then applying the second local cohomology functor (proof lines 1667-1672)
First route: the composite is right adjoint to the inclusion of the torsion category for the sum of the two ideals, which gives the identity of functors (proof lines 1673-1677)

Second route: the tensor product of the extended Cech complexes on generators of the two ideals is the extended Cech complex on the combined generators, which gives the same identity, and the final assertion follows (proof lines 1678-1687)
proof_roadmap: 先说清记号：RΓ_Y ∘ RΓ_Z 指先 RΓ_Z、再经挠子范畴的包含入 D(A) 作用 RΓ_Y。
路一：整个复合是 D_{(I+J)^∞-torsion}(A) ↪ D_{I^∞-torsion}(A) 的右伴随 ⇒ 由伴随唯一性得等式。
路二：由 local-cohomology-adjoint 的 Čech 描述，f_1,…,f_r 与 g_1,…,g_m 的扩展 Čech 复形之张量积就是合并生成元的扩展 Čech 复形 ⇒ 同一等式；末句由该引理得到。

The proof (source lines 1667-1688) first fixes the meaning of the composition, then gives two arguments: right adjointness of the composite and the identification of the tensor product of the two extended Cech complexes with the one attached to the combined generators (proof lines 1667-1687).
